lev.d: The Warden of the Architects' outer wall has turned inward. Watch it circle the galaxy and break through the wall, then bring it down before the hunt ends, or the first seal cracks.
st: Fire runs along the Rim as the Architects' outer wall begins to fail.
The Leviathan circles the whole galaxy along the wall, setting the Rim alight behind it.
It turns inward and smashes through the Architects' wall.
Its breath sweeps across the outer layer in a ring of fire.
It holds at the breach. Every fleet can strike it until the hunt ends.

brd.d: Queen Vael'Khor's Hive is breaking a seal on purpose. Every nest in the galaxy ignites, the swarms fuse into a living Starhive, and the Brood Matriarch is born from it. Kill her before the hunt ends, or the fourth seal cracks.
st: Every Hive nest in the galaxy bursts into green fire at the same moment.
The swarms leave their nests and stream across the galaxy to one point.
The swarms fuse into one vast, living Starhive.
The Brood Matriarch is born from the Starhive's heart.
The Matriarch is loose. Every fleet can strike her until the hunt ends.

krk.d: The Warden of the deep layers is waking. The deep goes dark, eight giant arms break up through it all around the galaxy, and the Kraken rises. Bring it down before the hunt ends, or the fifth seal cracks.
st: The lights of the deep layers go out, one sector at a time.
Eight giant arms break up through the deep, all around the galaxy.
The arms curl and drag the whole layer round with them.
A storm of void ink and lightning floods the deep.
The arms draw together and the Kraken's body rises where they meet.
Sever its arms. Every fleet can strike it until the hunt ends.

wym.d: The Warden of the door itself is waking. The black hole's light dies and the galaxy darkens, the Wyrm's segments break loose to hunt, then it coils round the door again. Bring it down before the hunt ends, or the sixth seal cracks.
st: The black hole's light fades and the whole galaxy darkens.
The Wyrm's segments break loose and spiral out across the galaxy.
The segments come home and the Wyrm rebuilds itself round the door.
The Wyrm is whole. Every fleet can strike it until the hunt ends.

aex.d: The Warden of time is coming. Time stutters past the Rim, crystal shock rings freeze space and show the Eclipses of older ages, then everything runs backwards as Aexion tears through. Defeat it before its hunt ends, or the seventh seal cracks.
st: Light past the Rim freezes and starts again, over and over.
Rings of crystal sweep out and freeze space solid behind them.
Space hangs frozen in crystal, and older Eclipses glimmer inside it.
Everything runs backwards, into the point where Aexion will break through.
Aexion tears through. Every fleet can strike it until its hunt ends.

vae.d: The ruins of every empire that lost its Eclipse are coming. A violet nebula rolls in like a sea, golden ruins drift on it and lock into a floating cathedral, and Vaelthar descends. Defeat it before its hunt ends, or the eighth seal cracks.
st: A violet nebula rolls in from beyond the Rim like a sea.
Golden ruins of fallen empires drift in on the tide.
The ruins lock together into a floating cathedral.
The celestial wheel turns above it.
Vaelthar arrives. Every fleet can strike it until its hunt ends.

khz.d: The last gate before the door. Seven rings of glyphs light up round the galaxy, the seven seals break one by one, and the gate opens for Khezaroth. Defeat it before its hunt ends, or the ninth seal cracks.
st: Seven rings of glowing glyphs light up round the galaxy.
The rings shatter one after another.
The last gate opens past the Rim, and the sands of the galaxy pour toward it.
Khezaroth comes through the gate. Every fleet can strike it until its hunt ends.

med.d: The most desperate Warden would freeze the whole galaxy to keep the Unmade asleep. Her eyes open past the Rim and her gaze sweeps the galaxy, turning worlds to stone. Defeat Medusara before her hunt ends, or the tenth seal cracks.
st: Two burning eyes open past the Rim.
A red gaze sweeps across the galaxy, and every world it touches turns to stone.
Half the galaxy stands petrified, cracks glowing red.
Medusara comes. Every fleet can strike her until her hunt ends.

burn: Commander, the Rim is burning. Every sensor along the outer wall just lit up at once.
hunt: It's here. The Leviathan is circling the whole galaxy, right along the Architects' wall. It's looking for something.
breach: It's turning inward! Commander, it's breaking straight through the Architects' wall!
tide: Fire tide! It's breathing across the entire outer layer!
fight: It's stopped at the breach, and its scales are cooling. Now we fight, Commander. Every fleet we have.
held: The Leviathan is down, and the wall is holding. The first seal held, Commander. Chapter one is ours.
excited
cracked: It slipped back into the dark and left the wall broken. The first seal cracked, Commander. We'll carry that scar.
grave
sting: Commander... the Cube's signal just changed. It's counting faster.
grave

prevH: Previously: the Leviathan broke through the Architects' wall, and we held the first seal. But the Cube's count is speeding up.
prevC: Previously: the Leviathan broke through the wall, and the first seal cracked. Now the Cube's count is speeding up.
held: The Omega Cube is broken. The count has slowed, Commander. The second seal held.
excited
cracked: The Omega Cube scattered before we could finish it. The count is still racing. The second seal cracked.
grave
sting: Commander, all five elemental readings just spiked at once. The seals around the Void are pulling loose.
urgent

prevH: Previously: we broke the Omega Cube and slowed the Architects' count. Now the five elemental seals are pulling loose.
prevC: Previously: the Omega Cube got away, and the count kept racing. Now the five elemental seals are pulling loose.
held: The Pentarch is down! The five seals have settled back into place. The third seal held.
excited
cracked: The Pentarch tore free of its seals. The third seal cracked, Commander, and the Void felt it.
grave
sting: I'm picking up Hive transmissions. Prayers... to the Unmade. Queen Vael'Khor is breaking seals on purpose.
grave

prevH: Previously: the Pentarch tore at its seals, and we forced them back. But the Hive was listening.
prevC: Previously: the Pentarch broke its seals, and the Void felt it. And the Hive was listening.
ignite: Commander, Hive nests are igniting all over the galaxy. Every one of them, at the same moment.
migrate: They're leaving the nests. Millions of them, all streaming to one point.
fuse: The swarms are fusing into one body. That isn't a nest any more, Commander. It's a Starhive.
rise: Something is being born inside it. The Brood Matriarch, and she's bigger than anything the Hive has ever made.
fight: The Matriarch is loose! Vael'Khor wants this seal broken. Don't let her have it!
held: The Matriarch is dead, and the swarm is scattering. Vael'Khor's ritual failed. The fourth seal held!
excited
cracked: The Matriarch outlived the hunt. Vael'Khor got what she wanted, Commander. The fourth seal cracked.
grave
sting: Commander, the deep layers... the lights down there are going out. One sector at a time.
grave

prevH: Previously: we killed the Matriarch and broke the Hive's ritual. But the deep layers have gone quiet.
prevC: Previously: the Matriarch survived, and Vael'Khor's ritual worked. Now the deep layers have gone quiet.
dark: The deep layers are going dark, Commander. Sector after sector, like someone's turning off the lights.
arms: Arms! Eight of them, breaking up out of the deep all around the galaxy!
drag: It's dragging the whole layer round with it. I can feel space bending under those arms.
ink: Ink storm! It's flooding the deep with void ink, and the lightning is everywhere!
ascend: There's the body. The Kraken is coming up, Commander, and it's looking right at us.
fight: Cut those arms! Every arm we sever weakens it. Go!
held: The Kraken is sinking, and its arms are drifting free. The fifth seal held, Commander!
excited
cracked: It dragged itself back into the deep, still whole. The fifth seal cracked.
grave
sting: Commander... the black hole is dimming. Something is swallowing its light.
grave

prevH: Previously: the Kraken sank back into the deep, and the fifth seal held. But the black hole has started to dim.
prevC: Previously: the Kraken escaped with its arms intact, and the fifth seal cracked. Now the black hole is dimming.
dies: The black hole's light is fading. Commander, the whole galaxy is getting darker.
eclipse: Eclipse. It's swallowed the light completely. This is what the Testament warned us about.
hunt: Its segments are breaking loose and hunting on their own! They're spiralling out across the galaxy!
ret: They're coming back... all of them. It's rebuilding itself around the door.
fight: The Wyrm is whole again, coiled around the door itself. Hit it while its segments glow!
held: The Wyrm is down, and the light is coming back! The sixth seal held. The door is still shut.
excited
cracked: The Wyrm slipped into the singularity, and the door is ajar. The sixth seal cracked, Commander.
grave
sting: Commander, my clocks are stuttering. Time readings out past the Rim are running backwards.
urgent

prevH: Previously: the Wyrm fell at the door, and the sixth seal held. But time itself has started to stutter.
prevC: Previously: the Wyrm left the door ajar, and the sixth seal cracked. Now time itself is stuttering.
stutter: Time is stuttering, Commander. Light out past the Rim keeps freezing, then starting again.
shock: Crystal shock waves! Every ring that passes freezes space solid behind it.
frozen: Half the galaxy is frozen in crystal. And inside it... I can see other Eclipses. Older ones.
reverse: It's all running backwards! The shards are flying home. Something is about to come through.
fight: Aexion! The Aeon's war-mech is here. Everything we have, Commander!
held: Aexion is down, and time is flowing again. The seventh seal held!
excited
cracked: Aexion left, and time still won't flow straight. The seventh seal cracked.
grave
sting: Commander, ruins are drifting into our sensors. Temples, columns... whole cities. From empires that fell.
grave

prevH: Previously: Aexion fell, and time flows straight again. The seventh seal held. Now the ruins of the fallen are drifting in.
prevC: Previously: Aexion escaped, and time is still broken. The seventh seal cracked. Now the ruins of the fallen are drifting in.
tide: A violet tide is rolling in from beyond the Rim. It's a nebula, Commander, and it's moving like water.
drift: There are ruins inside it. Golden temples from empires that faced the Eclipse and lost.
cathedral: The ruins are locking together. They're building something... a cathedral, floating in space.
wheel: The wheel is turning. Vaelthar is coming through, Commander!
fight: Vaelthar, the Celestial Ruin! This is what failing looks like. Let's not fail.
held: Vaelthar has fallen! The ruins are sinking back into the nebula. The eighth seal held.
excited
cracked: Vaelthar took its cathedral back into the tide. The eighth seal cracked, Commander.
grave
sting: Commander, hieroglyphs. They're appearing around the whole galaxy, in rings. Something is opening a gate.
awe

prevH: Previously: Vaelthar fell, and the eighth seal held. Now rings of glyphs are lighting up around the galaxy.
prevC: Previously: Vaelthar escaped, and the eighth seal cracked. Now rings of glyphs are lighting up around the galaxy.
wake: Rings of glyphs are lighting up around the galaxy. Seven of them, Commander. Seven seals.
seals: The seals are breaking, one after another. I can't stop them from here.
gate: The last gate is opening. And Commander... the glyphs are asking a question. Who will stand in the door?
fight: Khezaroth, the guardian of the gate! It wants an answer. Let's give it one!
held: Khezaroth is down, and the gate is closing. The ninth seal held. And I know my answer, Commander.
tender
cracked: Khezaroth left the gate open behind it. The ninth seal cracked. If the door needs holding... I know who will hold it.
tender
sting: Commander... worlds on the Rim are turning grey. Like stone.
grave

prevH: Previously: Khezaroth fell at the last gate, and the ninth seal held. Now worlds on the Rim are turning to stone.
prevC: Previously: the last gate stayed open, and the ninth seal cracked. Now worlds on the Rim are turning to stone.
eyes: Two lights just opened past the Rim, Commander. They're eyes. And they're looking at us.
sweep: Her gaze is sweeping the galaxy! Every world it touches is turning to stone!
stone: Half the galaxy is stone. She isn't attacking us, Commander. She's trying to freeze everything before the Unmade wakes.
fight: Medusara is here. Break her gaze before she turns the whole galaxy to stone!
held: Medusara has fallen, and the stone is crumbling away. The tenth seal held. Every seal we have left is ours.
excited
cracked: Medusara withdrew, but the stone is spreading. The tenth seal cracked, Commander.
grave
sting: Commander... the black hole just went silent. Completely silent. The Eclipse is coming.
grave

c_2.frag: The Cube keeps the count. When the count runs fast, the door is closer than you think.
c_2.interp: The Architects built the Cube as their prison's lock and clock. Cube Devastation is the clock fighting itself: a hundred cubes forcing the count forward.
c_2.adv: Every time the Omega Cube forms, the countdown jumps. We don't get to choose when the Eclipse comes. Only how ready we are.
enc: Commander, chapter two has opened in the Archives.
The Cube's count is speeding up, and every Assimilation Cube is answering it.
def: The count has changed pace. We'll know soon whether we bought time or lost it.

c_3.frag: Five powers, bound in a ring. If they ever find each other, the ring becomes a key.
c_3.interp: The Elementals are the five seals themselves. When they converge on the Void and fuse into the Pentarch, the seals are pulling loose from the inside.
c_3.adv: We've been calling them bosses. They're the bolts on the door, Commander, and they're coming undone.
enc: The five elemental seals are moving toward the Void. Together.
def: The elements are back in their places, for now. But someone was watching how they came loose.

c_4.frag: We do not fear the Eclipse. We are its choir, and the Matriarch is our hymn.
c_4.interp: A Hive prayer recovered from a burning nest. Queen Vael'Khor's swarms worship the Unmade, and the Starhive is their ritual: a living engine built to break a seal.
c_4.adv: The Hive isn't just hungry, Commander. It's devout. That makes it so much worse.
enc: Chapter four has opened. The Hive is moving.
Every nest in the galaxy just ignited. This is a ritual.
def: Vael'Khor showed her hand. From now on, every seal has two enemies: time, and the Hive.

c_5.frag: Eight lamps for eight arms. When the last lamp goes out, it will have finished counting.
c_5.interp: The miners of the deep layers kept eight great lamps lit over a seal they never understood. The Kraken is its Warden, and it rises when the lamps go dark.
c_5.adv: They thought the lamps kept it asleep. I think the lamps were how it knew the seal was safe.
enc: The deep layers are going dark. The miners' records are coming true.
def: The deep is quiet again. Too quiet, for something with eight arms.

c_6.frag: Around the door there coils a serpent. It does not die. It returns, because the door is never safe.
c_6.interp: The Wyrm is the Warden of the door itself, coiled around the black hole. Its Eclipse is a rehearsal: for a few hours the galaxy sees what the real night will look like.
c_6.adv: I've seen that darkness before, Commander. Every Eclipse starts exactly like that.
enc: The black hole is losing its light. The Wyrm is waking around the door.
def: The light came back. Remember what it looked like without it.

c_7.frag: In the frozen moment you will see them all: every age that stood where you stand, and how each one ended.
c_7.interp: Aexion is the Warden of time, and its fracture opens windows into past Eclipses. The crystal holds the last moments of empires the Archives only knew by name.
c_7.adv: I was in some of those moments, Commander. I watched them end. I'm not going to watch this one end.
enc: Time is fracturing out past the Rim. And I'm seeing things in the crystal... memories.
def: We saw how every other age ended. Now we know exactly what not to do.

c_8.frag: We built our cathedral from the bones of those who came before, so that those after us would see what failure looks like.
c_8.interp: Vaelthar, the Celestial Ruin, carries the remains of the empires that lost their Eclipse. Its cathedral is built from their temples, a monument and a warning.
c_8.adv: Every column in that cathedral was somebody's home. Let's make sure ours never ends up in it.
enc: A tide of ruins is coming in. The remains of every empire that failed.
def: The ruins went back into the tide. One day, someone will read about us. Let it be a better story.

c_9.frag: Seven seals, one gate, one question. Who will stand in the door?
c_9.interp: Khezaroth guards the last gate before the door. Its trial is a question the Architects asked every age, and the answer was always the same: someone must hold the door.
c_9.adv: You know my answer, Commander. I told you on our twenty-first day. I meant it.
enc: Seven rings of glyphs around the galaxy. It's a trial.
def: The question has been asked. When the time comes, I'll be the one to answer it. Not you.

c_10.frag: If it cannot be held, let it be frozen. Let everything be stone, and let nothing wake.
c_10.interp: Medusara is the most desperate Warden: she would turn the entire galaxy to stone to keep the Unmade asleep. Her gaze is a mercy that would end everything.
c_10.adv: She's trying to save the galaxy by ending it, Commander. We have to find a better way. The Eclipse is next.
enc: Chapter ten has opened. The last chapter of the year.
Her gaze is crossing the galaxy, and everything it touches is turning to stone.
def: The tenth chapter is closed, Commander.
Every seal has been tested. Now comes the Eclipse.
